$comment: Provisional canonical identifier. JSON Schema is the source of truth for form instance structure. Form transport in email is not specified in this draft.
title: Forms capability
description: Structured forms a mailbox may ask correspondents to complete before or as part of communication. Each entry identifies a form and points at a JSON Schema. Clients MAY render natively, open an optional web representation, or ignore forms they cannot handle.

id.description: Stable identifier for this form within the mailbox's published set. Not globally unique by itself.

version.description: Form definition version (extension-owner or mailbox-owner controlled). Distinct from Discovery Protocol and core schema versions.

schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema that defines valid form instance data. Fetching and applying this schema is subject to security considerations (malicious URLs, schema resource limits).

web.description: Optional human-usable web form URL. Clients that cannot render the JSON Schema MAY open this URL with user consent.
